title: AI-generated renderings of Incident 2: row of red lights over a desert dirt road at night
description: Two nearly identical AI-generated night scenes labeled "Incident 2", each showing a dirt two-track road running toward distant mountains under a starry sky with the Milky Way. A horizontal row of small red lights hovers just above the horizon at left, and a pair of headlights sits on the road ahead. In the second image the lights are fainter and lower. Marked UNCLASSIFIED, page 6.
